newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - May 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - May 14.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Egyptian president hopes to boost relations with Iraq.
- Kuwait rejects bill banning concerts and fashion shows.
- Gulf Arab states need $208 billion to develop the industrial sector until the year 2005.
- Beirut Bank starts marketing bonds worth $50 million in London this week.
- Saudi's National Agriculture Development Company's new dairy plant to raise production capacity at a cost of 309 million riyals.
- OPEC has lost $11 billion in three months because of lower oil prices, OPEC president says.
- Agricultural growth in Tunisia shows an increase of 17 percent between 1990 and 1996.
